fuente.titulo: Pope urges Peruvians to build a society based on respect, inclusion, solidarity

titular: Pope urges Peru to build inclusive, caring society
bajada: In Lima, he calls for solidarity with families, women and workers
caption: Speaking in Lima after hearing testimonies from Peruvian citizens, Pope Leo XIV addressed the challenges facing families, women, workers and a culturally diverse nation, urging greater solidarity and commitment to the common good. Source: Vatican News, Nov 12, 2026.

ilustracion.descripcion: A plaza in Lima at dusk with a crowd gathered before a stage; a figure in white papal vestments stands at a podium in the upper right third, left and center open and uncluttered.
